bug_semantics: Authenticated builder users can make the Budibase server fetch loopback or private HTTP targets by DNS-rebinding a hostname that is public during blacklist validation and internal at connect time. OpenAPI query import (packages/server/src/api/controllers/query/import/index.ts) calls assertUrlIsSafe()/blacklist.isBlacklisted on the hostname and then a separate node-fetch of the original URL, so the connection is not pinned to the validated address. REST datasource/query execution (packages/server/src/integrations/rest.ts) later calls fetchWithBlacklist() with a custom undici fetchFn that installs getDispatcher(); undici re-resolves the original hostname and ignores any Node http(s).Agent pin on the helper.
flaw_origin: ba9f7724b342491b8274f2c218494b386bf352a9 (Improve security on query import, Adrià Navarro Redó, 2026-03-23) first wrote the OpenAPI validate-then-unpinned-fetch TOCTOU: assertUrlIsSafe plus fetch(currentUrl, {redirect: "manual"}). Immediate parent f4c9bd1ec6ea2fdae4b2fa8e16a8cabab2f1b8bd still had fetchFromUrl as an unguarded fetch(url) with no blacklist check and no assertUrlIsSafe. A later REST remaining sink (9273dfb98130a5673a515d8f1708fbeb2fcbe9ce introducing local fetchWithBlacklist+setDispatcher, then 7a966383e141001a572f56d419832e32290ef660 wrapping an undici fetchFn around the shared helper) added dispatcher-based re-resolution; 6688802467e3fb6f5231ab7338941b97cbca232f pinned only the Node agent, which undici does not honor. None of these are a move, revert, or squash of a finer public member.

reasoning: The advisory is a remaining authenticated SSRF via DNS rebinding after hostname blacklist validation, not the earlier unguarded OpenAPI fetch. The smallest public commit that first wrote that OpenAPI TOCTOU (blacklist then unpinned fetch of the original hostname) is ba9f7724; the parent still fetched without any blacklist/pin, so the TOCTOU lines are parent-absent. REST undici re-resolution is a later remaining sink of the same advisory, first written as blacklist-then-dispatcher fetch in 9273dfb and then wired to the shared helper in 7a966383; 668880's Node-agent pin does not bind undici. Closing remediation is PR #19178, whose direct sink patch is 1fecb3fc, landed by merge 343a6529 and present from 3.39.30 through the advertised 3.40.0 patched boundary.
